_comment: TEAM-SHARED Claude Code settings (committed to git per Anthropic convention). The env block enforces the team's privacy posture (no telemetry, no error reporting, no feedback surveys/command, no Generated-with-Claude-Code attribution header, no autoupdater). The permissions allow-list standardizes bash command access. The hooks block IS the harness layer — every script under .claude/hooks/ is wired here. Each hook has a .cjs (Option A primary) and .sh (Option B fallback) sibling; if a team member's machine lacks node, swap each command from `node ...cjs` to `bash ...sh`. For PERSONAL machine-local overrides, create .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored by Anthropic default) — settings there take precedence over this file. Never paste API keys in either settings file — use a gitignored .env via /setup.
